description: Department of Inland Revenue - Notice in relation to the circumstances in which losses on financial instruments
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal notice issued by the Commissioner General of Invenue under Section 18(4) of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. It specifies regulatory circumstances for setting losses against gains on financial instruments, making it a matter of legal/regulatory framework rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
